source_title: Pixelated 123: The primary value is the clock
source_excerpt:
Welcome to Pixelated episode 123. This week, Damien and Abner share their earliest impressions of the Fitbit Edge, Google’s latest fitness tracker that promises to split the difference between the Fitbit Air and the Pixel Watch 5. After, the gang gets bleak about the future of RAM prices before turning their attention to Apple one last time to ask… good lord what is happening in there?
